```{r}

dgi <- read.csv('New Data/New Drug Gene Interactions csv.csv',row.names = 1)

dgi_subset <- dgi[1:50, ]

# Convert to matrix
mat <- as.matrix(dgi_subset[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- dgi_subset[[1]]

# ── Full n×n Jaccard similarity matrix ──────────────────────────────────────
n <- nrow(mat)
sim_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n, dimnames = list(rownames(mat), rownames(mat)))

for (i in 1:n) {
  for (j in 1:n) {
    common <- sum(mat[i, ] == 1 & mat[j, ] == 1)
    total  <- sum(mat[i, ] == 1 | mat[j, ] == 1)
    sim_matrix[i, j] <- if (total == 0) 0 else round((common / total) * 100, 2)
  }
}

# ── Extract pairs above threshold ───────────────────────────────────────────
threshold <- 20   # change as needed

# Only upper triangle to avoid duplicate pairs (Drug A vs B = Drug B vs A)
pairs <- which(upper.tri(sim_matrix) & sim_matrix >= threshold, arr.ind = TRUE)

similar_pairs <- data.frame(
  drug_1         = rownames(sim_matrix)[pairs[, 1]],
  drug_2         = colnames(sim_matrix)[pairs[, 2]],
  common_genes   = apply(pairs, 1, function(idx) sum(mat[idx[1], ] == 1 & mat[idx[2], ] == 1)),
  total_genes    = apply(pairs, 1, function(idx) sum(mat[idx[1], ] == 1 | mat[idx[2], ] == 1)),
  similarity_pct = sim_matrix[pairs]
) |>
  arrange(desc(similarity_pct))

# ── View results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(sim_matrix)        # full matrix
print(similar_pairs)     # filtered pairs
```

```{r}
# Check your column names first to be sure
# colnames(dgi_subset)

# 1. Update this to the correct column name or index
# If the names are in the first column, keep [[1]]. 
# If they are in a column named 'Drug', use dgi_subset$Drug
drug_names <- dgi_subset[[1]] 

# 2. Convert to matrix, excluding the name column
# We use -1 to drop the first column from the math
mat <- as.matrix(dgi_subset[, -1])

# 3. Assign the names to the matrix
rownames(mat) <- drug_names
colnames(mat) <- colnames(dgi_subset)[-1] # (Optional: keeps gene names)

# --- Proceed with the math as before ---
intersection <- mat %*% t(mat)
row_sums <- rowSums(mat)
union <- outer(row_sums, row_sums, "+") - intersection
sim_matrix <- round((intersection / union) * 100, 2)
sim_matrix[is.nan(sim_matrix)] <- 0

# --- Extract with correct names ---
pairs_indices <- which(upper.tri(sim_matrix) & sim_matrix >= 20, arr.ind = TRUE)

similar_pairs <- data.frame(
  drug_1         = rownames(sim_matrix)[pairs_indices[, 1]],
  drug_2         = colnames(sim_matrix)[pairs_indices[, 2]],
  similarity_pct = sim_matrix[pairs_indices]
)

print(head(similar_pairs))
```

Finalll version 

```{r}
# Drug similarity based on gene interactions

library(dplyr)

threshold <- 0
min_genes <- 0

mat <- as.matrix(dgi)

gene_counts <- rowSums(mat == 1)
mat <- mat[gene_counts >= min_genes, ]

print(paste("Drugs remaining for analysis:", nrow(mat)))

# Intersection Matrix
intersection <- mat %*% t(mat)

row_sums_vec <- rowSums(mat)
union <- outer(row_sums_vec, row_sums_vec, "+") - intersection

# Calculate Jaccard Matrix
sim_matrix <- round((intersection / union) * 100, 2)
sim_matrix[is.nan(sim_matrix)] <- 0

pairs_indices <- which(upper.tri(sim_matrix) & sim_matrix >= threshold, arr.ind = TRUE)

similar_pairs <- data.frame(
  drug_1         = rownames(sim_matrix)[pairs_indices[, 1]],
  drug_2         = colnames(sim_matrix)[pairs_indices[, 2]],
  genes_drug_1   = row_sums_vec[pairs_indices[, 1]],
  genes_drug_2   = row_sums_vec[pairs_indices[, 2]],
  common_genes   = intersection[pairs_indices],
  similarity_pct = sim_matrix[pairs_indices])


similar_pairs <- similar_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    d1 = min(drug_1, drug_2), 
    d2 = max(drug_1, drug_2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-drug_1, -drug_2) %>% 
  rename(drug_1 = d1, drug_2 = d2) %>%
  relocate(drug_1, drug_2) %>%
  arrange(desc(similarity_pct))

# View final result
similar_pairs
```


```{r}
# Drug similarity based on chemical fingerprints

drug_cf <- read.csv('New Data/Chemical Fingerprint New Drugs csv.csv', row.names = 1)

threshold_cf <- 0
min_cf <- 0

mat_cf <- as.matrix(drug_cf)

cf_counts <- rowSums(mat_cf == 1)
mat_cf <- mat_cf[cf_counts >= min_cf, ]

print(paste("Drugs remaining for analysis:", nrow(mat_cf)))

# Intersection Matrix
intersection_cf <- mat_cf %*% t(mat_cf)

row_sums_vec_cf <- rowSums(mat_cf)
union_cf <- outer(row_sums_vec_cf, row_sums_vec_cf, "+") - intersection_cf

# Calculate Jaccard Matrix
sim_matrix_cf <- round((intersection_cf / union_cf) * 100, 2)
sim_matrix_cf[is.nan(sim_matrix_cf)] <- 0

pairs_indices_cf <- which(upper.tri(sim_matrix_cf) & sim_matrix_cf >= threshold_cf, arr.ind = TRUE)

similar_pairs_cf <- data.frame(
  drug_1         = rownames(sim_matrix_cf)[pairs_indices_cf[, 1]],
  drug_2         = colnames(sim_matrix_cf)[pairs_indices_cf[, 2]],
  cf_drug_1   = row_sums_vec_cf[pairs_indices_cf[, 1]],
  cf_drug_2   = row_sums_vec_cf[pairs_indices_cf[, 2]],
  common_cf   = intersection_cf[pairs_indices_cf],
  similarity_pct_cf = sim_matrix_cf[pairs_indices_cf])

similar_pairs_cf <- similar_pairs_cf %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    d1 = min(drug_1, drug_2), 
    d2 = max(drug_1, drug_2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-drug_1, -drug_2) %>% 
  rename(drug_1 = d1, drug_2 = d2) %>%
  relocate(drug_1, drug_2) %>%
  arrange(desc(similarity_pct_cf))

similar_pairs_cf
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

drug_se <- read.csv('New Data/Drug and Side Effects csv.csv')

mat_se_raw <- table(drug_se$drugbank_name, drug_se$side_effect_name)

# Convert to binary (0 or 1) matrix
mat_se <- as.matrix(mat_se_raw > 0) + 0

threshold_se <- 0
min_se <- 0

se_counts <- rowSums(mat_se)
mat_se <- mat_se[se_counts >= min_se, ]

print(paste("Drugs remaining for side effect analysis:", nrow(mat_se)))

# Intersection Matrix
intersection_se <- mat_se %*% t(mat_se)

# Union calculation
row_sums_se <- rowSums(mat_se)
union_se <- outer(row_sums_se, row_sums_se, "+") - intersection_se

# Jaccard Matrix
sim_matrix_se <- round((intersection_se / union_se) * 100, 2)
sim_matrix_se[is.nan(sim_matrix_se)] <- 0

# Extract pairs
pairs_se <- which(upper.tri(sim_matrix_se) & sim_matrix_se >= threshold_se, arr.ind = TRUE)

similar_pairs_se <- data.frame(
  drug_1            = rownames(sim_matrix_se)[pairs_se[, 1]],
  drug_2            = colnames(sim_matrix_se)[pairs_se[, 2]],
  se_count_1        = row_sums_se[pairs_se[, 1]],
  se_count_2        = row_sums_se[pairs_se[, 2]],
  common_se         = intersection_se[pairs_se],
  similarity_pct_se = sim_matrix_se[pairs_se])

similar_pairs_se <- similar_pairs_se %>%
  arrange(desc(similarity_pct_se))

similar_pairs_se
```


```{r}

# Combine everything
final_report <- similar_pairs %>%
  inner_join(similar_pairs_cf, by = c("drug_1", "drug_2")) %>%
  inner_join(similar_pairs_se, by = c("drug_1", "drug_2")) %>%
  select(
    drug_1, drug_2,
    gene_sim = similarity_pct,
    chem_sim = similarity_pct_cf,
    se_sim = similarity_pct_se
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(chem_sim)) %>%
  arrange(desc(gene_sim))

final_report
```
